string.text: Makes the weapon more compact and lighter - unfortunately at the cost of accuracy and a wider pellet spread, and the weapon can no longer take a suppressor.
A special heat-resistant coating makes the barrel more resistant to adverse environmental conditions, improving reliability.
Increases muzzle velocity, thus increasing the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Improves reliability of the firearm by replacing standard parts of the trigger group with their reinforced counterparts.
An underbarrel foregrip makes the weapon more comfortable to handle, which makes firing and controlling recoil significantly easier.
Individual adjustment of the trigger mechanism parts improves accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Combines the functions of a narrow beam tactical flashlight and a laser sight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
A magazine extension tube allows to load more rounds, making reloads less frequent.
Allows to install various types of sights.
A polymer buffer built into the weapon slightly reduces felt recoil.
Balancing the standard trigger mechanism parts reduces muzzle climb when firing.
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Significantly improves accuracy and shooting comfort.
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts without any significant loss in other performance characteristics.
Improves obturation and accuracy by removing play in the chamber.
Special threading used for attaching a suppressor.
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
